note: Per-call raw SQL latency was measured on the same real SQLiteKnowledgeIndex corpus at 10k and 20k, run once on the AFTER working tree and once on the clean baseline c3ad4c6 via reversible git stash (no clone/worktree). CAUTION: per-call exact/lexical/dense raw latency on this machine is NOT reliably reproducible (high run-to-run variance: exact p50 @10k measured 65-181ms across runs; 20k p50 165-435ms). Absolute latency figures should be read as indicative, not authoritative. The measured, reproducible wins are in ELIMINATED CALLS per query (target_counter_contract), which the deterministic regression tests prove; that is where the pathological-repetition latency-reduction target applies. LIVE provider calls were not executed (remote authorization/cost absent); remote qualification latency is NOT included.
machine: Windows-AMD64, Python 3.13.15, SQLite 3.50.4, sqlite-vec 0.1.9, dim 1024, Intel64 Raptor Lake

reproducibility_check.conclusion: Per-call raw latency not a reliable metric on this machine; use the deterministic call-count and counter contract as the primary evidence
